convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMACD indicator. Simple MACD crossover entry/exit with fixed lots and fixed-pip TP. Standard MT5 Trade library includes for order management only (no custom indicator logic). No external .mqh libraries for trading logic, no multi-timeframe, no grid/martingale, no hedging logic.

derived_values.name: Adjusted point value for 3/5 digit brokers

params.note: value in pips, converted to price via m_adjusted_point

other_exits: Long position closed when MACD main crosses below signal (crossover in opposite direction)
Sell position closed when MACD main crosses above signal (crossunder in opposite direction)

custom_logic_notes: Long entry requires MACD main and signal both below zero (MacdCurrent<0 && SignalCurrent<0) at crossover - classic MACD strategy buying from below zero line. Short entry requires MACD main and signal both above zero (MacdCurrent>0 && SignalCurrent>0) at crossunder - selling from above zero line. Signal reversal closes opposite positions before new entry is possible (since total==0 gate ensures no open positions exist). Margin check requires FreeMargin >= 1000*Lots before opening any position. The hedging check in OnInit is commented out but indicates the EA was designed for hedging accounts.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward MACD crossover strategy. Key conversion points: (1) Digit adjustment logic - multiply TP pips by 10 for 5-digit/3-digit brokers; (2) Entry uses previous bar crossover (index [1]) with current bar confirmation (index [0]); (3) Zero-line filter on both main and signal for entry; (4) No SL set on orders, only TP; (5) Signal reversal acts as exit but position_gate=no_position means only one position at a time; (6) Trade library includes are standard MT5 wrappers for order placement - map to broker API calls in Python; (7) Margin check: FreeMargin >= 1000 * Lots before entry.
